fact: At the D-8 health ministers meeting in November 2025 the Ministry's assistant minister presented the national health information exchange (HIE) platform connecting all providers and creating a unified electronic health record, with a 2030 target of a unified record for 109 million citizens.
title: وزارة الصحة: سجلًا صحيًا إلكترونيًا موحدًا لكل مواطن
